What a fantastic way to stop playing the hit and miss game with you skincare. Check what you own, get better choices and make lists of ingredients to look for and what to avoid all based on your specific profile. If you wonder which of your skin care collection is breaking you out or irritating your skin, Skinsort will find it for you and make recommendations on what to replace it with. Within 2 days of my seven day trial I knew I would formally subscribe.

I find this app useful in finding more suitable skincare products however many of the products added aren't available in the UK, prices often aren't shown and SkinSort are very biased against certain ingredients despite their ingredient descriptions suggesting otherwise. Such as SLS, petrolatum, paraffin etc which are perfectly safe and effective for many people but are misunderstood and feared. Even if you "like" these ingredients SkinSort still tries to hide products that contain them.
